title: Types of Polynomials and Geometrical Meaning of Zeroes — Polynomials
hook: Let's explore Types of Polynomials and Geometrical Meaning of Zeroes from the chapter on Polynomials. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Types of Polynomials and Geometrical Meaning of Zeroes Linear, quadratic, and cubic polynomials and their graphs. Zeroes are the x-coordinates where the graph crosses the x-axis. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Linear polynomial ax+b has exactly 1 zero (straight line graph)
💡 Quadratic polynomial ax²+bx+c has at most 2 zeroes (parabola)
💡 Cubic polynomial has at most 3 zeroes (S-curve)
💡 Zero of polynomial p(x): the value of x for which p(x) = 0
💡 Geometrically: zeroes = x-coordinates of points where graph meets x-axis
